stem: After an unusually severe dryback, media pulls away from the container wall and irrigation water rapidly exits along the side while the root ball stays partly dry. What should be addressed first?
choices: Restore uniform wetting and correct preferential flow before increasing nutrient concentration or event size
Increase fertilizer concentration so the drier portions of the media receive more dissolved ions during rewetting
Apply fewer measurements during rewetting so the media can expand without changes to the irrigation program
Treat rapid sidewall drainage as evidence that the full root ball has received enough water for the event
rationale: Media shrinkage can create preferential flow paths that bypass part of the root zone. Re-establishing uniform wetting is more appropriate than assuming rapid drainage means complete rehydration.
